newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 2.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Dec. 2:
WASHINGTON - The U.S. economy appears to have entered a period of stability in which recessions no longer seem inevitable and both inflation and joblessness remain relatively low.
WASHINGTON - The head of the District of Columbia financial control board wants the city to cut benefits for thousands of workers and welfare recipients.
MIAMI - Florida Governor Lawton Chiles is considering a state takeover of the city of Miami, in the midst of a massive financial mess.
ATLANTA - Decisions made by a juvenile court judge are seldom easy.
BELGRADE - A wide array of diplomats and Serbian officials predict that sooner or later Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic will be ousted from power in a bloody coup.
